botcomponent.description: Synthesizes an email thread into decisions, action items, open questions, and risks by owner, then offers to post a Teams recap and schedule a follow-up meeting. Use when the maker asks to recap, summarize, or catch up on an email thread or conversation, wants decisions or action items pulled out of an email discussion, or asks to turn an email thread into a Teams update or a follow-up meeting. Do NOT use for general inbox triage, drafting a reply, or requests that are not anchored to a specific thread's outcome.
botcomponent.name: email-thread-recap-followup
